subject: castle-walls-v4
label: Side walls, north wall, front-to-side corner, and a proper drawbridge gatehouse
notes: THE GAP THIS FILLS. v3 produced ONE wall orientation — a flat elevation seen face-on — which only works for the SOUTH wall. The east and west runs and the north run had no art at all, so the castle was a facade. Raheem, looking at the marked-up footprint: 'what walls are we gonna use for the vertical paths on the left and the right side? And what walls are we gonna use for the north wall?'

THE KEY INSIGHT, AND IT CHANGES THE VIEW PARAMETER. The south wall faces the camera, so it is drawn in ELEVATION (view: side). The east/west runs go away from the camera and the north run is on the far side — for those you are looking DOWN on the wall's parapet walkway, so they are drawn TOP-DOWN (view: low top-down). Same endpoint, different view. Getting this wrong is what would make the side walls read as a south wall lying on its back.

DATUM, agreed with Raheem and now fixed: tile 32px, ground line y=1216, camera zoom 2x (960x540 visible). Wall 384x288 (12x9 tiles), gate 288x320 (9x10), tower 288x384 (9x12), corner 192x288 (6x9). Every dimension below is a whole number of tiles so pieces snap without nudging.
SIDE WALL TILES VERTICALLY, NOT HORIZONTALLY. It runs north-south on screen, so its repeat axis is Y. 192x384 = 6x12 tiles. Seam is authored on the top and bottom edges rather than left and right.

THE GATE IS THE OTHER HALF OF THIS BATCH. The v3 gatehouse was structurally fine but read wrong. Raheem: 'That more looks like a prison door... I want something like a drawbridge, let the drawbridge down so the horses run in.' 23% of that sprite also turned out to be leftover background trapped inside the arch and behind the merlons — fixed separately by a colour knockout, not a re-roll. What is being re-generated here is the DESIGN: a lowered timber drawbridge on chains, twin flanking turrets, a real threshold you could ride a horse over.

PALETTE IS THE MEASURED ONE AND IT IS NOT POST-PROCESSED. Sampled from the approved kit: honey-gold sandstone rgb(214,184,145)-(224,188,137) at R-B +69 to +88, cream highlight rgb(204,188,162), violet-grey brick rgb(119,109,117)-(89,78,87). Raheem on v3: 'I like the palette. The colour is perfect. It matches the rest of the castle.' So it is stated in the prompt and then LEFT ALONE — no ramp_transfer. Logged twice now: forcing a palette onto art that is already right washes it out and killed the gold.

NO BAKED BACKGROUNDS. Every prompt says standing alone against transparency. Two v3 pieces came back with a drawn background — one an actual painted transparency checkerboard — and enclosed regions behind merlons and inside arches cannot be reached by an edge flood-fill. Cheaper to ask for it than to repair it.

images.note: The one Raheem actually wants — horses through it, not a prison door.
